env.ROS2_SETUP: if [ -f /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash ]; then source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; else eval "$(mamba shell hook --shell bash)" && mamba activate ros2_env; fi

tasks.label: colcon build
tasks.command: eval "$ROS2_SETUP" && nice -n 10 colcon build --symlink-install --executor sequential --cmake-args -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON && eval "$MERGE_CC"

tasks.label: colcon build (this package)
tasks.command: eval "$ROS2_SETUP" && nice -n 10 colcon build --symlink-install --executor sequential --packages-select ${input:pkg} --cmake-args -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON && eval "$MERGE_CC"
